Layer: engineered — **offline only, USD $0.00**. Every cloud leg is a

made or claimed (REQ-XB-212 live evidence is owed by R6.47).

## Landed

- `scripts/gce-backend.sh` (bash 3.2) — the single provisioning home;
  admitted `gcloud` only. `quote | provision | verify | prepull |
  deliver-secret | status | harvest | teardown | inventory`. Exits:
  7 missing tool · 2 `Refused{}` · 4 `Unsupported{backend.*}` ·
  5 leak-scan · 6 inconclusive/h_r.
- `hh-compute-decl/1` + `hh-compute-receipt/1` closed schemas +
  validators — declarations refuse unknown/missing fields, image
  families, unpinned packages, non-IAP ingress, Spot, service accounts,
  missing `D`, restart > 1 h; receipts are verbatim command logs +
  resources + verification + teardown `post_state` + settlement clock +
  `cost_record: n/a{compute_cost_record: R6.14}`, leak-scanned before
  every write.
- Nine-step unskippable teardown (§3.9/F14) — harvest required before
  delete; `inconclusive{}` on WARNING/failure (exit 6), never "empty";
  only admitted deviation: stopped+disk under a dated `DF-*` row inside
  `h_r`; phase-close `projects delete` → `DELETE_REQUESTED`.
- `deliver-secret` — §3.11 stdin-only path into tmpfs 0400; never
  argv/metadata/disk/receipts; refuses $0/unauthorized/restart-only.
- `quote` — `pre-quote` quantities only incl. `H_rs`, `h_r`,
  `E_gib{estimated}`; `pricing: n/a{compute_pricing: R6.14}`; zero
  network calls.
- `restart-only` (Q-X60) — `instances start`, ≤1 h,
  harvest+teardown only.
- `compute-open.sh` (REQ-XB-211) · `compute-gate-span.sh` (REQ-XH-009) ·
  `hh-runner::diskwatch` + `r6_13.rs` (REQ-XB-207).
- `check-gce-backend.sh` — deterministic fake-shim battery **79/79**.
- CI: `ci-mode: both` schema step + `mode != 'fast'` battery step.
- ADR-0431 (AR-15); BL-47 `+= ADR-0431`; generated triggers + index
  regenerated.
